description: This file defines a ChatLog class for managing chat message components, including user messages, assistant responses, tool executions, and system messages, within a UI framework.

classes.name: ChatLog
classes.description: A UI component class for managing and displaying a chat log with various message types and tools.

methods.name: dropComponentReferences
methods.description: Removes references to a component from internal maps and variables.

methods.name: pruneOverflow
methods.description: Removes oldest children when exceeding max components.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds a component to the chat log and prunes overflow if necessary.

methods.name: clearAll
methods.description: Clears all messages and resets internal state, optionally preserving pending users.

methods.name: restorePendingUsers
methods.description: Re-adds pending user messages to the chat log.

methods.name: clearPendingUsers
methods.description: Removes all pending user messages.

methods.name: createSystemMessage
methods.description: Creates a system message container.

methods.name: addSystem
methods.description: Adds a system message to the chat log.

methods.name: addUser
methods.description: Adds a user message to the chat log.

methods.name: addPendingUser
methods.description: Adds a pending user message, which can later be committed or dropped.

methods.name: commitPendingUser
methods.description: Marks a pending user message as committed.

methods.name: dropPendingUser
methods.description: Removes a pending user message.

methods.name: hasPendingUser
methods.description: Checks if a pending user message exists.

methods.name: reconcilePendingUsers
methods.description: Reconciles pending users with a history of user messages.

methods.name: countPendingUsers
methods.description: Returns the number of pending user messages.

methods.name: resolveRunId
methods.description: Resolves a run ID, defaulting to 'default' if undefined.

methods.name: startAssistant
methods.description: Starts or updates an assistant message for a given run ID.

methods.name: updateAssistant
methods.description: Updates the text of an existing assistant message.

methods.name: finalizeAssistant
methods.description: Finalizes an assistant message, removing it from streaming runs.

methods.name: dropAssistant
methods.description: Removes an assistant message from the chat log.

methods.name: showBtw
methods.description: Displays a BtwInlineMessage with specified parameters.

methods.name: dismissBtw
methods.description: Removes the BtwInlineMessage from the chat log.

methods.name: hasVisibleBtw
methods.description: Checks if a BtwInlineMessage is currently visible.

methods.name: startTool
methods.description: Starts or updates a tool execution component.

methods.name: updateToolArgs
methods.description: Updates arguments for a tool execution.

methods.name: updateToolResult
methods.description: Updates the result of a tool execution, optionally as an error or partial result.

methods.name: setToolsExpanded
methods.description: Sets whether tools are expanded or collapsed.
